project_witness_proposal.label: Triptych sixfold study arrangement of 1861 Kyrie glosses (not approved English)
project_witness_proposal.caution: Six study utterances arranged from two exact historical English glosses. The 1861 Mass itself is ninefold and does not print this complete arrangement. Its older P./R. actors are not inherited. This is not approved English or a text for recitation.

english.reading_note: Sixfold Triptych study arrangement of the exact 1861 English glosses; not a verbatim 1861 Mass body or approved Missal English.
english.note: Six project utterances repeat the two exact 1861 gloss phrases in K, K, C, C, K, K order. The older Mass prints nine Greek calls and one English gloss per set; that source body is not pasted or relabelled here. The 2002 n. 7 sixfold pattern supplies structural comparison evidence only. Printed V./R. boundaries support the declared dialogue roles. No older P./R. actor or priest/cantor allocation is imported. Complete authenticated 2008 fidelity and approved English remain unestablished. This is study material, not a text for recitation.

target_turn_proposal.basis: Secondary 2002 artifact page 305, n. 7 visibly prints three pairs: V. Kyrie/R. Kyrie; V. Christe/R. Christe; V. Kyrie/R. Kyrie. These printed boundaries support alternating versicle/response roles, without assigning priest or cantor actors. The 1861 source P./R. cues belong to a different ninefold Mass context and are not reused as target role proof.

preserve_conditions_exact.basis: Ordo Missae n. 7 and IGMR 51, as transcribed and sourced in src/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/postconciliar/2008-latin-2011-us-english/ordinary/00-order-of-mass/sections/10-introductory-rites.tex:96-103.
